unstyled.open: The pinned shared panel only checks Mind Archive's legacy overlay.open for its merge-dialog bridge; Clipbind does not create this class.
unstyled.overlay: The pinned shared panel only detects Mind Archive's reusable merge overlay. Clipbind uses its own native dialogs and never creates this class.
unstyled.suite-preference: The two actual header buttons are styled by [data-settings-slot]>button in entry.css, including their 44 px targets, focus and hover states.

dead.Use: The CSS-in-JS heuristic joins the reset confirmation prose into .Use. This is a sentence, not a class selector.
